posts.title: October 2026: Sophie Takes Calls
posts.description: Sophie moves into my dad's house with a family app in both stores, the Platform gets MCP and a view-only link, a 2018 DeepRacer drives again, and Hack24 returns rewritten in Swift.

posts.title: September 2026: Sophie Gets Her Own Server
posts.description: Sophie moves onto her own server with a proper care console, The Platform lets anyone drive a robot without signing up, and the myCobot comes back from the dead.

posts.title: Sanbot Elf: a native ROS 2 driver, in action
posts.description: The Sanbot Elf now speaks ROS 2 itself, from a Kotlin app on its own Android board, with no bridge PC in between. Here it is working, with the numbers and the parts that still aren't right.
